decisions.statement: A subagent row's context value says whether that subagent was stopped.
A stop reaches only a row that is a subagent.
The subagent stopped is named as its page is named, read off the page the row names.
A row naming no page stops nothing and says so.
A subagent stopped already is left as it is.
A stop is confirmed before anything is asked of the harness.
The confirmation says the stop takes effect at the subagent's next model turn.
The confirmation says a subagent inside a tool call finishes that call first.
A stop asks `akasha agent subagent-stop` through the harness, as a seat's acts do.
A stop that failed is said on the channel and shown to Alan.
A stop asks for the file again rather than waiting to be told.

definition: a subagent stopped from the agents panel, confirmed and then asked of the harness
